tools.name: lookup_part
tools.description: Look up one hardware part number in the EOSL.ai database. Returns support status, End-of-Sale and End-of-Service-Life dates, support runway score, and the primary vendor bulletin URL backing the dates. Matching is exact, then punctuation-insensitive, then Fortinet short-SKU aliases (FG-60E -> FortiG

tools.name: bulk_check
tools.description: Check up to 200 part numbers in one call. Returns a per-part row (status, EOSL date, source URL, page URL) plus summary counts: past, endingSoon, supported, active, notFound.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search tracked product families by vendor, product line, or series name (case-insensitive substring, e.g. "nexus 9300"). Returns up to 10 families with status, EOSL window, and page URL. Use get_family with a returned slug for the full record.

tools.name: get_family
tools.description: Fetch the full source-backed record for one product family by slug (from search_models or lookup_part pageUrl): lifecycle dates per SKU group, every part number, support runway score factors, and the vendor bulletin URLs.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: List all vendors tracked by EOSL.ai with family counts and vendor page URLs.

description: List all vendors tracked by EOSL.ai with family counts and vendor page URLs. Read-only, no parameters. Use this first to check whether a vendor is covered at all; for specific models use search_models, for a part number use lookup_part.
